# Data provenance

**Every record in this project is synthetic.** It is generated by the code in this repository from a fixed seed. No
external, scraped, licensed or personal data is used, read or downloaded at any point.

## Where the data comes from

| Item | Source |
|---|---|
| Products, brands, subcategories, variants | Invented lists in `generator/master/CategoryCatalog.java`. The brand names (for example Harvestry, Voltiq, Threadory) were made up for this project and are not meant to refer to any real company or trademark. |
| Prices, costs, MRP, MAP | Drawn from distributions with `java.util.Random` streams seeded from `SHA-256(seed\|stream\|key)` (`docs/generator_design.md`) |
| Competitors | Three fictional competitors, `COMP_ALPHA`, `COMP_BETA` and `COMP_GAMMA`, whose prices are a seeded random walk. No real retailer's prices are observed or scraped. |
| Customers | Opaque random tokens (`CUST-0000001` …). There is no name, contact, address, payment or device data, and tokens are not linked to any person. |
| Orders, inventory, promotions, decisions | Simulated by the day loop (`MarketSimulator`) and the pricing engine |
| Anomaly labels | Produced by the injector at generation time and written only to `labels/` |

## Reproducibility

- **Seed and settings determine everything.** With `generator.seed` (default 20261022) and the scale profile fixed, a
  dataset can be regenerated byte for byte on any JVM or platform.
- **Verifying a dataset.** `manifest.json` records the command line, seed, scale, rule version and a SHA-256 for each
  file, and `checksums.sha256` verifies them with `sha256sum -c`.
- **Proof.** `scripts/repro_check.sh` regenerates the data and compares the checksums;
  `docs/evidence/reproducibility_report.md` holds the result.

## Lawful use

- The data contains no personal information, so data-protection obligations do not arise (for example India's Digital
  Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, or the GDPR).
- Any resemblance of a generated product, brand or price to a real one is coincidental.
- The data is meant for testing, demonstration and evaluation of pricing and data-quality software. It must not be
  presented as real market, competitor or customer data.
- Code and generated data are released under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`.
